title: AWSFlowLogsIntegration
description: Organization-scoped AWS Flow Logs onboarding record.

name.description: Display label for this AWS Flow Logs integration record.

siteId.description: AWS cloud site id linked to this AWS Flow Logs integration.

awsAccountId.description: AWS account ID that will post flow logs into REAP.

region.description: Customer-selected AWS region stored with the onboarding record.

status.description: Whether REAP currently accepts AWS Flow Logs for this record.

vpcIds.description: Discovered local VPC IDs included in the generated customer onboarding template.

transitGatewayIds.description: Discovered local transit gateway IDs included in the generated customer onboarding template.

resourceSnapshotAt.description: Discovery topology timestamp used to build the flow logs resource snapshot.
